name: zerchers-squat.html
instructions:
1. Set up a bar at roughly navel height.
2. Position the bar in the crook of the elbow between the bicep and forearm.
3. Inhale, stand up tall, and take 2 or 3 steps backward away from the J hooks.
4. Descend by flexing at the knees and hips simultaneously.
5. Once your thighs reach parallel with the floor, begin to reverse the movement.
6. Keep your abs braced and drive your feet through the floor.
7. Finish the lift by exhaling as you fully extend the hips and knees.
8. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
